1. \( c = -1 \) (from p(0) = -1)
2. \( a + b + c = 2 \) (from p(1) = 2)
3. \( a - b + c = -4 \) (from p(-1) = -4)

1. \( a + b - 1 = 2 \) => \( a + b = 3 \)
2. \( a - b - 1 = -4 \) => \( a - b = -3 \)

Subtracting: \( 2b = 6 \) => \( b = 3 \)

So, the polynomial is \( p(z) = 3z - 1 \).
